newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 96/97 lead, zinc demand seen weaker - MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan 96/97 lead, zinc demand seen weaker - MITI.

text.p: Japan's demand for refined lead in the business year ending in March 1997 is expected to total 265,000 tonnes, down by 1.5 percent from the previous year, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Monday.
Japan's demand for refined zinc will slip by 1.3 percent from the previous year to a total of 618,000 tonnes in 1996/97, reflecting slower demand for zinc-coated steel sheets, MITI said in a report.
An expected fall in lead demand was attributable to weaker demand from battery makers, as increasing imports of batteries put pressure on demand for domestic batteries, a ministry official said.
Japan's lead output in 1996/97 was projected to rise by 3.3 percent to 231,000 tonnes, MITI said.
